pages.text: $(thing)Damping-off$() ($(o)Pythium spp.$()), oomycete.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() all crops.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() soilborne.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 10-25 °C (best 15 °C).

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 5 years (soil).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 100% yield, can kill the plant.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Sow into warm, well-drained soil; Avoid overwatering seedbeds; Treated seed.
